verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes an official MCP server (intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server) with 145 tools covering full CRUD for 29 entity types and 11 reports, OAuth2 handling, and configurable write-restriction options, plus official developer docs page confirming it. missing for 10: independent/third-party hands-on validation of the MCP server in production and clarity on maintenance/support status beyond the repo itself.
